{"notes": "VISIT 1 (left at 1:45). The table was empty in the picture: no dominoes placed, nothing connected to a start. Ratings are provisional because I have little evidence so far.

Maya: At 1:15 she announced a new plan: start at the nose, two lines running back and crossing at the tail neck. She gave clear roles (Priya traces stroke 1, she takes stroke 2, Tom clears the old tail stuff, then helps on the tail ends). That is real leadership and direction. But I didn't see her confirm the sketch reached Priya, and nothing was built while I was there. Check whether the replan cost the team time, and whether she followed up.

Priya: At 1:30 she spoke up that her pad still showed the old start by the tail, and asked whether the new sketch went through. She was ready to trace stroke 1 as soon as START moved. Good collaboration and good catch. I can't blame her for the lack of progress, since she was waiting on a fix. Ask whether it got resolved.

Tom: Assigned to clear the old tail dominoes. I saw no response or action from him. I can't tell whether he did it, since the picture shows nothing placed at all. Don't mark him down without more evidence; ask him.

Leo: Not seen or heard on this visit, and no assignment from Maya. Unknown contribution. Possibly left out of the plan, which would be a gap in Maya's delegation. Watch him next visit and ask him privately.

Open question: whether the pad/sketch mismatch was a tool problem or a communication problem. Nothing is built yet and time is short."}
